items.structure: Ilium: Iliac fossa, Iliac crest, Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS), Anterior inferior iliac spine (AIIS)
items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: landmarks on hip bone (SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_R/_L): iliac fossa (internal ala), iliac crest, ASIS, AIIS
items.custom_note: Smooth concave internal (medial) surface of the ala of the ilium, above the arcuate line and in front of the auricular surface; both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: landmarks on hip bone: ischial spine, ischial tuberosity
items.custom_note: Large roughened posteroinferior prominence of the ischium (sitting bone; hamstring origin), both sides.

items.structure: Pubis: Superior and Inferior pubic rami, Pubic tubercle, Pubic symphysis
items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: pubic rami/tubercle on hip bone; pubic symphysis (interpubic disc) not modeled, lies between the two hip bones
items.custom_note: Bar of the pubis from the acetabulum to the pubic body, forming the upper border of the obturator foramen; both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: notches on posterior border of hip bone (above/below ischial spine)
items.custom_note: Smaller notch of the posterior border between the ischial spine and the ischial tuberosity, both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: foramen bounded by pubis and ischium of hip bone
items.custom_note: Opening of the hip bone between the pubis and ischium, drawn as a thin sheet filling the hole (where the obturator membrane lies; obturator canal at its upper edge); both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: cup on lateral hip bone at ilium/ischium/pubis junction
items.custom_note: Cup-shaped socket on the lateral hip bone, found as the bone surface facing the femoral head (sphere fitted to the real femur, r~24 mm), both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: proximal femur (SRC_Z_FEMUR_R/_L)
items.custom_note: Constricted neck joining the head to the shaft between the head and the trochanters/intertrochanteric line; both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Skeletal framework
items.note: proximal femur
items.custom_note: Conical posteromedial projection below the neck (iliopsoas insertion), both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Hip joint
items.note: fibrocartilage rim of acetabulum on SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_R/_L, around SRC_Z_FEMUR_* head
items.custom_note: Fibrocartilaginous rim on the margin of the acetabulum (deepens the socket, grips the femoral head), open inferiorly at the acetabular notch where the transverse acetabular ligament bridges; built on the rim of the real hip bone; both sides.

items.structure: Ligament of the head of the femur (ligamentum teres)
items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Hip joint
items.note: acetabular fossa/notch of SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_* to fovea of femoral head (SRC_Z_FEMUR_*)
items.custom_note: Flat intracapsular band from the acetabular notch/transverse ligament to the fovea of the femoral head; carries the artery of the ligament of the head; mostly hidden inside the joint (hide the femur or hip bone to see it); both sides.

items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Superficial gluteal muscles
items.note: 3 muscles

items.structure: Tensor fasciae latae and Iliotibial tract (IT band)
items.section: Gluteal Region and Hip > Superficial gluteal muscles
items.note: TFL exists; iliotibial tract absent in z-anatomy (lateral thigh, TFL/glut max to lateral tibial condyle)
items.custom_note: Thickened lateral band of the fascia lata on the lateral thigh, receiving tensor fasciae latae and gluteus maximus and running down over vastus lateralis to the anterolateral (Gerdy) tubercle of the lateral tibial condyle; added to the real TFL; both sides.

items.note: between greater sciatic notch of SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_*, sacrum (SRC_Z_SACRUM) and sacrospinous lig (absent); piriformis (SRC_Z_PIRIFORMIS_MUSCLE_*) passes through
items.custom_note: Opening from the pelvis to the gluteal region: greater sciatic notch closed by the sacrospinous and sacrotuberous ligaments (not modelled; spanned to the real sacrum/coccyx); piriformis passes through it, with the superior gluteal vessels/nerve above and the sciatic, inferior gluteal, pudendal nerves below; both sides.

items.note: inguinal ligament (absent), sartorius (SRC_Z_SARTORIUS_MUSCLE_*), adductor longus (SRC_Z_ADDUCTOR_LONGUS_*); contains femoral a/v (SRC_Z_FEMORAL_ARTERY_*, SRC_Z_FEMORAL_VEIN_*)
items.custom_note: Triangular space of the upper anterior thigh: inguinal ligament (base), medial border of sartorius (lateral), medial border of adductor longus (medial; apex where sartorius crosses it); drawn as a sheet on its floor (iliopsoas, pectineus, adductor longus) just behind the real femoral vessels (N-A-V lateral to medial); both sides.

items.note: 3 muscles
adductor minimus = upper part of adductor magnus, included

items.structure: Adductor part of adductor magnus (adductor part and hamstring part)
items.note: adductor (pubofemoral) and hamstring (ischiocondylar) parts not separately modeled
items.custom_note: Medial vertical part of adductor magnus from the ischial tuberosity down to the adductor tubercle (its tendon forms the medial edge of the adductor hiatus); tibial division of the sciatic nerve. Split from the real muscle along its medial border; both sides.

items.note: deep to sartorius (SRC_Z_SARTORIUS_MUSCLE_*), between vastus medialis (SRC_Z_VASTUS_MEDIALIS_MUSCLE_*) and adductor longus/magnus; contains femoral a/v
items.custom_note: Intermuscular tunnel of the middle third of the thigh from the apex of the femoral triangle to the adductor hiatus: roof sartorius (open side of the gutter), anterolateral wall vastus medialis, posterior wall adductor longus/magnus; drawn as a gutter around the real femoral artery and vein (with saphenous nerve, nerve to vastus medialis); both sides.

items.structure: Biceps femoris, long and short heads
items.note: 2 heads
no lower-limb nerves in either model; via greater sciatic foramen above piriformis, between gluteus medius and minimus (with SRC_Z_SUPERIOR_GLUTEAL_ARTERY_*)
items.custom_note: L4-S1: through the greater sciatic foramen above piriformis (with the real superior gluteal artery), then laterally between gluteus medius and minimus to tensor fasciae latae. Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; via greater sciatic foramen below piriformis to deep gluteus maximus (with SRC_Z_INFERIOR_GLUTEAL_ARTERY_*)
items.custom_note: L5-S2: through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis (with the real inferior gluteal artery) into the deep surface of gluteus maximus. Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; S1-S2 twig to anterior surface of SRC_Z_PIRIFORMIS_MUSCLE_*
items.custom_note: Short S1-S2 branch entering the pelvic (anterior) surface of piriformis inside the pelvis. Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; below piriformis, around ischial spine via lesser sciatic foramen to SRC_Z_OBTURATOR_INTERNUS_*
items.custom_note: L5-S2: out below piriformis medial to the sciatic nerve, around the back of the ischial spine (with the pudendal nerve), back in through the lesser sciatic foramen to the pelvic surface of obturator internus (also supplies superior gemellus). Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; below piriformis, deep to gemelli/OI tendon to SRC_Z_QUADRATUS_FEMORIS_MUSCLE_*
items.custom_note: L4-S1: out below piriformis deep (anterior) to the sciatic nerve, down on the back of the ischium deep to the gemelli and obturator internus tendon into quadratus femoris (also inferior gemellus). Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; lateral to femoral artery (SRC_Z_FEMORAL_ARTERY_*) under inguinal ligament, groove between iliacus and psoas
items.custom_note: L2-L4: in the groove between psoas major and iliacus, under the inguinal ligament lateral to the real femoral artery (outside the femoral sheath), then fanning out in the femoral triangle (sartorius, quadriceps, saphenous branches). Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; along lateral pelvic wall to obturator foramen of SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_* (with SRC_Z_OBTURATOR_ARTERY_*)
items.custom_note: L2-L4: from the medial border of psoas along the lateral pelvic wall above the real obturator artery, through the obturator canal, splitting into anterior and posterior divisions around adductor brevis. Built. Both sides.

items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; below piriformis, posterior thigh deep to long head biceps (SRC_Z_LONG_HEAD_OF_BICEPS_FEMORIS_*) to popliteal fossa
items.custom_note: Medial (anterior-division, L4-S3) half of the sciatic nerve, from the sacral plexus in front of piriformis, out below piriformis, down between greater trochanter and ischial tuberosity (behind gemelli/OI/QF, deep to gluteus maximus) and on adductor magnus deep to the long head of biceps to the popliteal apex. Built: no lower-limb nerves in the donor. Both sides.

items.structure: Tibial division of the sciatic nerve
items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; medial division of sciatic nerve; continues as tibial nerve in popliteal fossa
items.custom_note: Continuation of the tibial division straight down the middle of the popliteal fossa, superficial to the real popliteal vein and artery, to between the heads of gastrocnemius. Built. Both sides.

items.structure: Common fibular division of the sciatic nerve
items.note: no lower-limb nerves in either model; lateral division of sciatic nerve; continues as common fibular nerve along biceps femoris
items.custom_note: Lateral (posterior-division, L4-S2) half of the sciatic nerve in the same sheath, alongside the tibial division to the popliteal apex. Built. Both sides.

items.custom_note: Medial of the two rounded distal expansions of the femur (articulating with the tibia/medial meniscus), both sides.

items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee

items.custom_note: Anterior grooved (trochlear) articular surface of the distal femur for the patella, both sides.

items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee
items.note: posterior distal femur between condyles
items.custom_note: Deep posterior notch between the femoral condyles that houses the cruciate ligaments, both sides.

items.note: superior articular surfaces of proximal tibia
items.custom_note: Flat superior articular surfaces of the medial and lateral tibial condyles (either side of the intercondylar eminence), both sides.

items.structure: Medial and Lateral condyles of the tibia
items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee
items.note: proximal tibia
items.custom_note: Medial expanded proximal end of the tibia (rim and sides below the articular surface; semimembranosus inserts posteromedially), both sides.

items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee
items.note: between tibial plateaus
items.custom_note: Raised central ridge (medial and lateral intercondylar tubercles) between the two plateaus; cruciates/menisci attach in front of and behind it; both sides.

items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee
items.note: anterior proximal tibia
items.custom_note: Anterior prominence of the proximal tibia below the condyles where the patellar ligament inserts, both sides.

items.section: Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee
Knee > Skeletal framework of the knee

items.note: quadriceps (SRC_Z_RECTUS_FEMORIS_MUSCLE_*, vasti) to base of SRC_Z_PATELLA_*
items.custom_note: Common tendon of rectus femoris and the three vasti, from just above the patella onto its base (built over the real muscles where they converge; z-anatomy runs the muscle tendons on through the patella); both sides.

items.note: apex of SRC_Z_PATELLA_* to tibial tuberosity (SRC_Z_TIBIA_*)
items.custom_note: Continuation of the quadriceps tendon from the apex of the patella to the tibial tuberosity; both sides.

items.note: C-shaped fibrocartilage on tibial plateau (SRC_Z_TIBIA_*) under femoral condyles
items.custom_note: C-shaped fibrocartilage (wider open C) on the periphery of the medial tibial plateau, horns towards the intercondylar area; attached to the tibial collateral ligament; both sides.

items.note: intercondylar: anterior tibia to medial side of lateral femoral condyle
items.custom_note: From the anterior intercondylar area of the tibia up, back and laterally to the medial surface of the lateral femoral condyle (posterior notch); prevents anterior tibial translation; both sides.

items.note: intercondylar: posterior tibia to lateral side of medial femoral condyle
items.custom_note: From the posterior intercondylar area of the tibia up, forward and medially to the lateral surface of the medial femoral condyle (anterior notch); prevents posterior tibial translation; both sides.

items.note: medial femoral epicondyle to medial tibia; lateral epicondyle to fibular head (SRC_Z_FIBULA_*)
items.custom_note: Flat band from the medial femoral epicondyle to the medial surface of the tibial shaft below the condyle; fused to the medial meniscus; resists valgus; both sides.

items.note: ASIS to pubic tubercle of SRC_Z_HIP_BONE_*
items.custom_note: Rolled lower border of the external oblique aponeurosis from the ASIS to the pubic tubercle (superior border of the femoral triangle; femoral vessels and nerve pass beneath it); built between the real bony landmarks, in front of iliopsoas and the femoral vessels; both sides.

items.note: gap in adductor magnus (SRC_Z_ADDUCTOR_MAGNUS_*) tendon above adductor tubercle of SRC_Z_FEMUR_*; femoral a becomes popliteal
items.custom_note: Gap between the adductor (aponeurotic) and hamstring (tendinous) insertions of adductor magnus above the adductor tubercle, drawn as a ring around the real femoral vessels where they pass back into the popliteal fossa and become popliteal; both sides.

items.note: diamond behind knee: biceps femoris, semimembranosus/semitendinosus, gastrocnemius heads; contains SRC_Z_POPLITEAL_ARTERY_*/VEIN_*
items.custom_note: Diamond-shaped space behind the knee: biceps femoris (superolateral), semimembranosus/semitendinosus (superomedial), the two heads of gastrocnemius (inferior); drawn as a sheet on its floor (popliteal surface of femur, capsule, popliteus) just in front of the real popliteal artery and vein (tibial and common fibular nerves most superficial); both sides.

items.note: internal iliac with its anterior/posterior divisions + external iliac
2 arteries

items.structure: Femoral artery Clinical: Common v. Superficial v. Deep
items.note: common/superficial femoral are segments of the femoral artery part (above/below the profunda origin); deep femoral separate

items.structure: Perforating arteries of the deep femoral artery
Medial and Lateral circumflex femoral artery
items.note: MCFA, LCFA + LCFA descending branch (right one unsuffixed in source)
from medial circumflex femoral (SRC_Z_MEDIAL_CIRCUMFLEX_FEMORAL_ARTERY_*) up femoral neck (SRC_Z_FEMUR_*) to head
items.custom_note: Branches of the real medial circumflex femoral artery (from the trochanteric fossa) running up the posterior/superior femoral neck under the retinacula to the head-neck junction: main head supply, torn in displaced neck fractures (AVN); both sides.

items.structure: Artery of the ligament of the head of the femur
items.note: from obturator artery (SRC_Z_OBTURATOR_ARTERY_*) along ligament of head of femur
items.custom_note: Small acetabular branch of the real obturator artery passing through the acetabular notch and along the ligamentum teres to the fovea (minor head supply in adults); both sides.

items.note: 2 veins
